mapper.select: select g.gift_name as giftName, u.user_name as userName,s.avatar, s.user_name as takingUserName,g.create_time as createTime from gift_user g left join tb_user u on u.user_id = g.user_id left join tb_user s on s.user_id = g.send_user_id order by g.create_time desc limit 5

select ifnull(sum(gift_money),0.00) from gift_user where 1=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')

select
ifnull(sum(gift_money),0.00)
ifnull(sum(ping_money),0.00)
from gift_user where 1=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')
